description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'LayoutTemplate' used by AddressTemplate and NameTemplate layouts within the OpenMRS project. It includes properties and methods for managing layout tokens, line formatting, element mappings, regex enforcement, and token conversion logic, serving as a base class for specific layout template implementations.

classes.name: LayoutTemplate
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for address and name layout templates, including token replacement, line parsing, and element mapping management.

methods.name: getLayoutToken
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the token used in the layout.

methods.name: getNonLayoutToken
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the token representing non-layout elements.

methods.name: replaceTokens
methods.description: Replaces special tokens in a line with the layout token.

methods.name: convertToTokens
methods.description: Converts a line into a list of token maps, identifying tokens and static text segments.

methods.name: getLines
methods.description: Processes the line-by-line format into a nested list structure of token maps.

methods.name: getCodeName
methods.description: Returns the code name of the layout.

methods.name: setCodeName
methods.description: Sets the code name of the layout.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country associated with the layout.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country associated with the layout.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the layout.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the layout.

methods.name: getElementDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves default element values.

methods.name: setElementDefaults
methods.description: Sets default element values.

methods.name: getElementRegex
methods.description: Gets regular expressions used for element validation.

methods.name: setElementRegex

methods.name: getElementRegexFormats
methods.description: Gets formats for displaying element examples.

methods.name: setElementRegexFormats
methods.description: Sets formats for displaying element examples.

methods.name: getLineByLineFormat
methods.description: Returns the list of line format strings.

methods.name: setLineByLineFormat
methods.description: Sets the list of line format strings.

methods.name: getRequiredElements
methods.description: Retrieves the list of required element identifiers.

methods.description: Sets the list of required element identifiers.

methods.name: getMaxTokens
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of tokens in a line, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: setMaxTokens

methods.description: Returns the map of code names to display names.

methods.name: setNameMappings

methods.name: getSizeMappings
